page.layout: Two parallel columns of word-list entries, left column Basque words in italic, right column Latin words in roman. Running head and page number at the top right. No marginal notes, no text below the columns.
page.notes: The left column's Basque headwords are set in italic with long s and accents as printed. The ¶ marks before Gaitzerraitecac, Haice and Iaincona are printer's signs. A small mark follows Haortchoa and was not transcribed. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: Emazthea (the z ligature), Hilebeth and Hortz. The right column's "Menfis." is printed with a long s, transcribed as Mensis.
